امتلكتن (form VIII)
# اِمْتَلَكْتُنَّ (imtalaktunna) /im.ta.lak.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِمْتَلَكَ (imtalaka)
# اُمْتُلِكْتُنَّ (umtuliktunna) /um.tu.lik.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِمْتَلَكَ (imtalaka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
